items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: D. Henry Thonazee, is that how you pronounce that? L-A-N-A-U-Z, I guess. And he also recorded something on this page, if I can read it. It's D.D.'s birth certificate, huh?

ctx.x: This is a marriage license. And it states that Mr. Joseph Lacroix Pierce and Miss Willie Goodson were married on the 28th day of March 1935. And this is recorded in the parish of Orleans. It was recorded April the 9th, 1935. And the same being duly recorded in book number 53. D. Henry Thonazee, is that how you pronounce that? L-A-N-A-U-Z, I guess. And he also recorded something on this page, if I can read it. It's D.D.'s birth certificate, huh?
